name: Kiso A-0904 60

planets.name: B
planets.note: K6, ~0.8 Msun at 1.96"; likely equal-mass binary; separation agrees with earlier astrometry

images.wavelength_label: H band 1.6 um (total intensity; companion detection)
images.credit: Valegard et al. 2024, Fig. 1 thumbnail (crop); companion detected, no disk in polarized light

paper.title: Disk Evolution Study Through Imaging of Nearby Young Stars (DESTINYS): The SPHERE view of the Orion star-forming region

notes: Young star in the Orion star-forming region observed by DESTINYS; the held SPHERE/IRDIS H-band total-intensity image recovers its previously known wide (several hundred au) stellar companion, while no disk is detected in polarized light (Valegard et al. 2024).
